messages.subject: worker-a.txt created; test run 0 pass / 2 fail (no node_modules)
messages.body: Created spike/worker-a.txt containing exactly 'worker A ok' (git status shows only spike/ untracked; nothing committed or pushed). bun test src/utils/test-run-scope.test.ts reported 0 pass / 2 fail / 2 errors across 2 files, but every failure is environmental: this worktree has no node_modules, so 'zod' cannot be resolved (the pretest build:opencode step and the test imports both fail), and no test assertion actually ran. To get meaningful counts, run bun install in this worktree first; I did not, to stay within the single-file ownership constraint (note: I re-ran the test once more to capture the error head, same result).
